name: 功山寺佛殿
checkpoints: THREE-bay main hall plus surrounding mokoshi, TWO eave bands, one principal storey.
Steep hip-and-gable roof with fine hinoki-bark layers, rich brackets, central doors and cusped windows on the outer bays.
No foreground fence, lantern shrine, placards, trees or added tower storey.
